verdict.rationale: Temporal's task-queue model lets multiple Workers pull from the same queue for automatic load balancing, and docs explicitly cover tuning Workers/Task Queues for resource management (temporal-docs-29), plus serverless Worker autoscaling for Lambda/Cloud Run (temporal-docs-22, temporal-docs-28). A hands-on user confirms the architecture's purpose: distributing work across machines with automatic retry on failure, i.e., tolerating worker loss (temporal-comm-7), reinforced by crash-proof execution guarantees (temporal-docs-1) and default Activity retries (temporal-docs-4). Missing for 10: quantified throughput-scaling benchmarks, explicit documentation of the load-balancing algorithm across a worker fleet, and independent performance testing under worker failure.
